events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the 35th anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost him, but Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Vibe
angles.copy: On this day in '65, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that pushed boundaries. Still spinning it today?

events.title: John Lennon Remembered
events.blurb: Today marks the 46th anniversary of the passing of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Impact
angles.copy: Forty-six years on, and John Lennon's music and message still resonate. A true legend, gone too soon.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Visionary artist David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie 80 Tribute
angles.copy: The Starman would have turned 80 today. David Bowie's influence on music, fashion, and culture is simply immeasurable.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: The King's 92nd
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. Still shaking, rattling, and rolling through our playlists.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock icon Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Page Turns 83
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped generations of rock. What's your favourite Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Legendary singer Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod Stewart's 82nd
angles.copy: Still rocking! Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Sir Rod Stewart. What's your go-to Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs, born Graham McPherson, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs 66
angles.copy: Our House, in the middle of our street... it's Suggs' 66th birthday! Wishing the Madness legend a very special day.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young's 71st
angles.copy: Wherever I lay my hat, that's my home... and today it's Paul Young's 71st birthday! Still loving those 80s classics.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend and icon Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly's 81st
angles.copy: What a woman! Wishing the incredible Dolly Parton a very happy 81st birthday. An absolute legend.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and singer-songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Barlow's 56th
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! Still got that magic touch.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: British R&B and soul singer Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Billy Ocean's 77th
angles.copy: Get outta our dreams, get into our cars... and wish Billy Ocean a very happy 77th birthday! An 80s icon.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony.

angles.name: Hall Of Fame Firsts
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame opened its doors for the first time. Who was in that first class? And who would you induct today?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark Owen's 55th
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to the always youthful Mark Owen of Take That!

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their iconic final live performance on the Apple Corps rooftop on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Rooftop Flashback
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert. What an iconic way to say goodbye!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis drummer and hugely successful solo artist Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil Collins' 76th
angles.copy: In the air tonight... it's Phil Collins' 76th birthday! A true musical powerhouse.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Renowned British actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Hugh Grant's 67th
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the charmingly awkward Hugh Grant! From rom-com king to versatile character actor, what's your favourite of his roles?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT Turns 46
angles.copy: It's gonna be May... well, it's January 31st, and it's Justin Timberlake's 46th birthday! Pop icon still bringing the moves.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Del Boy's 87th
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason. What's your favourite of his iconic characters?

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks the tragic anniversary of the plane crash that claimed the lives of Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper in 1959.

angles.name: Music Died Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, who we lost on this day in 1959. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: 'Never Gonna Give You Up' singer Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Rick Astley's 61st
angles.copy: We're never gonna give him up! Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley. Still a pop legend!

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Marley 82 Tribute
angles.copy: One love! Remembering the legendary Bob Marley, who would have turned 82 today. His music continues to inspire.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Celebrated singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Carole King's 85th
angles.copy: You make me feel like a natural woman... and it's Carole King's 85th birthday! Celebrating a true songwriting icon.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: Today marks the 15th anniversary of the passing of the incomparable vocal talent, Whitney Houston.

angles.name: Whitney Tribute
angles.copy: Fifteen years ago, we lost a voice like no other. Remembering the phenomenal Whitney Houston today. Her music lives on.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, pop titans Take That announced their initial split, devastating fans worldwide.

angles.name: Take That Devastation
angles.copy: Remember where you were when Take That first split up? Today marks 31 years since the news broke!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Ali Campbell's 68th
angles.copy: Red, Red Wine... and a very happy 68th birthday to UB40's Ali Campbell! Still bringing the reggae vibes.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Ed Sheeran's 36th
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! What's your favourite track from the Suffolk singer-songwriter?

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: The Beatles' lead guitarist George Harrison would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: Harrison 84 Tribute
angles.copy: The Quiet Beatle would have been 84 today. Remembering the incredible talent of George Harrison.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: The Who frontman and rock legend Roger Daltrey celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Roger Daltrey's 83rd
angles.copy: Hope he gets what he wants! Happy 83rd birthday to The Who's iconic frontman, Roger Daltrey.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: British pop singer-songwriter Nik Kershaw celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Nik Kershaw's 69th
angles.copy: Wouldn't it be good... to wish Nik Kershaw a very happy 69th birthday! Still loving those 80s synth-pop hits.

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Coldplay frontman Chris Martin celebrates his 50th birthday today.

angles.name: Chris Martin's 50th
angles.copy: It was all yellow... and now it's Chris Martin's 50th birthday! Wishing the Coldplay frontman a fantastic day.

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Bon Jovi frontman and rock icon Jon Bon Jovi celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Bon Jovi's 65th
angles.copy: Whoa, we're halfway there! Happy 65th birthday to the legendary Jon Bon Jovi. Still a rock star!

events.title: Chris Rea would have been 76
events.blurb: Beloved British singer-songwriter Chris Rea would have celebrated his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Chris Rea Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the smooth sounds of Chris Rea, who would have been 76 today. His music always feels like driving home for Christmas.
